title: Balance-Size Months — Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Payment Arrangements
content:
**Truth table guidance.** Balance-size months are added to the term of a new Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility payment arrangement according to the account's patient balance together with the statement cycle printed on its latest statement:

- a balance of at least 1000.00 on a cycle of at least 3 adds 2 months;
- a balance of at least 400.00 but below 1000.00 on a cycle of at least 3 adds 1 month;
- any other account adds none.

| Patient balance | Latest statement cycle at least 3 | Months added |
|---|---|---|
| 1000.00 or more | yes | 2 |
| 1000.00 or more | no | 0 |
| 400.00 up to 999.99 | yes | 1 |
| 400.00 up to 999.99 | no | 0 |
| below 400.00 | either | 0 |

Hypothetical cases: a balance of 1000.00 on cycle 3 adds 2; 999.99 on cycle 4 adds 1; 1500.00 on cycle 2 adds none.
